posts.title: Audi patents car dashboard buttons that can hide away
posts.description: There's no shortage of patented new in-car innovations flying around the automotive industry—some of them actually see the light of day sometimes, while many others die a quiet death and never make it to production. This time, two patents from German automakers promise to adjust the driving experience in a couple of very different ways. Read More

posts.title: SUV Review: 2027 Kia Telluride X-Pro SX-Prestige AWD
posts.description: There’s a theory in retail sales that once a product (or the place where that product is bought) becomes a habit or routine, customers are very likely to become regulars. Witness long line-ups at Tim Hortons across this country — yet a lot of people complain about the coffee and baked goods. But if a double-double and Boston Cream are part of the morning routine, people are likely to just go there on autopilot. Read More

posts.title: Ontario family seeks to return EV after getting zapped by cable
posts.description: The Ontario owners of a 2027 Chevrolet Bolt say they're looking to go back to a gasoline vehicle after one of them reportedly felt an electrical shock whilst moving the car’s charging cable across a driveway. Read More
